verdict.summary: Automating remains a compact automation-kit repository with a real tested Cloudflare worker subcomponent, but the current working tree is not RC-ready: local master is 15 commits behind origin/master, six paths are dirty, and the modified pack-sync path contains two material safety/correctness regressions that are not present in origin/master.
strengths: Automation-kit responsibility is explicit through .automation, consumer-src, synchronization tooling, and GitHub workflows.
The nested agent-trigger worker has a deterministic Node test suite.
All three agent-trigger worker tests pass in the current workspace.
SHA verification and release/branch fallback logic are explicitly implemented in the pack-sync tooling.
risks: Local master is 15 commits behind origin/master, so the current working tree is not based on the current upstream baseline.
The modified ShouldThrottle function references zipName, consumerSlug, and tag outside their valid execution context while Set-StrictMode Latest is enabled.
The modified pack-sync script recursively removes targetRoot before copying, while packs.json configures targetRoot as '.', creating a repository-root deletion hazard.
The primary pack-sync path has no evidenced deterministic test covering throttling, target-root safety, synchronization, or destructive-path guards.
The worktree contains staged, modified, deleted, and untracked state, including an AD .automation.zip index/worktree mismatch.
next_actions: Do not execute the current modified automater-pack-sync.ps1 against a consumer repository.
Reconcile the 15 upstream commits with the local dirty worktree without losing unrelated local work.
Remove the out-of-context template expansion from ShouldThrottle and place expansion only after tag and asset names are resolved.
Replace unconditional targetRoot recursive deletion with an explicitly bounded synchronization strategy that cannot remove repository root.
Add deterministic tests for targetRoot='.', throttling, asset-template expansion, SHA256SUMS parsing, and synchronization safety.
Re-run the Quality Atlas assessment after the worktree is reconciled and the pack-sync safety path is verified.
notes: Repository mutation, staging, commit, push, fetch, pull, runtime restart, and destructive execution were not performed because execution authority is READ_ONLY.

The configured Symfony/PHP application runtime is not applicable here because the repository has no root composer.json and the assessed implementation is primarily PowerShell/GitHub automation plus a nested Node worker.
Behavioral verification executed only where safely applicable: .automation/ai/agent-trigger/worker npm test passed 3/3.
No browser/mobile UI change is present in the assessed working tree; visual evidence is NOT_VERIFIED / not applicable.

runtime.summary: Runtime confidence is materially reduced because the modified pack-sync execution path contains out-of-context strict-mode variable references and an unconditional recursive targetRoot removal while targetRoot is configured as repository root.
